title: CTK-03 Local Node Event Bus and Transport Adapter
purpose: Provide a pub/sub event bus and transport adapter abstraction connecting Locaily Node instances for event routing, topic subscriptions, and inter-node event envelope delivery.
problem: CTK-01/02 allow local nodes to evaluate capabilities and plan execution, but event routing requires a formal event bus and transport layer to publish events and dispatch them to eligible node subscribers.

included: Event bus module with topic subscriptions, wildcards (*, #), and handler dispatching
LocalTransport and RelayTransport abstractions for transmitting event envelopes between Nodes
Delivery provenance tracking and failure handling for unreachable subscribers
CLI integration and acceptance test suite scripts/test-node-event-bus.js

acceptanceCriteria.description: Event bus supports topic subscriptions with wildcard pattern matching (*, #)
Transport adapter delivers event envelopes across node boundaries to registered subscribers
Event bus records delivery provenance (published_at, delivered_to, latency_ms)
Subscriber execution errors or transport timeouts are caught and recorded without crashing event bus
